title: Meet Jacob Coxon, Ex-Anthropic Researcher Who Sparked A Debate On AI Safety
summary_full: Jacob Coxon, who graduated from Cambridge in 2020, led to a debate with his warning about how AI labs were "gambling" with the lives of people.
